svg.title: Released baseline identity
svg.desc: An Operating Organization owns Logical Documents, each with Business Revisions and immutable Generations. Generation manifests identify Artifacts and may pin Structure Snapshots. A Release Record pins exact Generations, structure and approval evidence so later Working Heads cannot alter the released baseline.
